full_text:
DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES
Public Records Request
R013006-070526
Status: Final Response
Payments: $0.00

MESSAGE LOG: On 7/17/2026 12:39:31 PM, Nicolas Hernandez wrote:
Dear CDSS Public Records Act Unit,
This message is in response to your "Final Response" dated July 17, 2026, and the associated PDF document, SOC_Form_Links.pdf, made available through the portal.
While I acknowledge that your office has provided a table containing hyperlinks to a sub-segment of translated forms, your response remains critically non-compliant and legally inadequate under California law. I hereby formally object to the closure of this request and demand full compliance with the following statutory requirements:
1. Failure to Search and Disclose Core Requested Records (Gov. Code § 7922.535)
2. Failure to Produce Electronic Records in Native Formats (Gov. Code § 7922.570)
3. Systemic Language Access Failures under the Dymally-Alatorre Bilingual Services Act (Gov. Code §§ 7295.2 & 7295.4)
